n8n compensates for fewer built-in integrations than Zapier through the HTTP
Request node, which can call any API [16].

## Built-in vs Community Nodes

| Aspect | Built-in | Community |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Maintainer | n8n team | Community developers |
| Count | ~400 | ~5,800 |
| Cloud availability | All | ~25 verified initially [42] |
| Self-hosted | All | All (after install) |
| Naming convention | n8n-nodes-base.* | n8n-nodes-* or @scope/n8n-nodes-* |
| Package keyword | N/A | n8n-community-node-package |

As of May 1, 2026+, publishing requires GitHub Actions with provenance
statement [38].

## API Access

| Endpoint | Operations | Source |
|----------|-----------|--------|
| `/rest/workflows` | CRUD for workflows | [39] |

REST API enables programmatic workflow management. Authentication documented at
docs.n8n.io/api/authentication/ [39].

## Webhook Node

- Creates HTTP endpoints for external services to trigger workflows [41]
- Two modes: test (development) and production [41]
- Can return workflow results (acts as API endpoint) [41]
- Supports all standard HTTP methods

## HTTP Request Node

- Sends HTTP/HTTPS requests to external APIs [3]
- Supports all HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS
- Extensive configuration: authentication, headers, query parameters, body data
- Enables integration with any API, even without a dedicated node [16]

## Code Node

| Aspect | Details | Source |
|--------|---------|--------|
| Languages | JavaScript and Python | [40] |
| JavaScript | Sandboxed Node.js context | [40] |
| Python | Task runners (added v1.111.0); Pyodide legacy removed in v2 | [40] |
| Replaces | Legacy Function and Function Item nodes (from v0.198.0) | [40] |
| Performance | Python slower due to compilation overhead | [40] |

### External Module Support

| Environment | JavaScript | Python | Source |
|-------------|-----------|--------|--------|
| n8n Cloud | Cannot import external npm modules | N/A | [52] |
| Self-hosted (default) | Blocked by default | Blocked by default | [52] |
| Self-hosted (config) | `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL` | `N8N_RUNNERS_EXTERNAL_ALLOW` | [52] |
| Built-in modules | `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN` | `N8N_RUNNERS_STDLIB_ALLOW` | [52] |
